name: Bis-TOM
summary: Bis-TOM, or 2,5-TOM, also known as 4-methyl-2,5-dimethylthioamphetamine or as 2,5-dithio-DOM, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to DOM. It is the analogue of DOM in which the methoxy groups at the 2 and 5 positions have been replaced with methylthio groups.

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known from laboratory studies of DOM analogues.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，僅見於 DOM 類似物的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，仅见于 DOM 类似物的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is DOM with both of its oxygen atoms swapped for sulphur. Sulphur sits directly below oxygen in the periodic table, so it makes the same bonds while changing the molecule's size and greasiness.
fact.zh: 它是把 DOM 的兩個氧原子都換成硫的產物。硫在週期表中正位於氧的下方，因此能形成相同的鍵，卻改變了分子的大小與親油性。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 DOM 的两个氧原子都换成硫的产物。硫在周期表中正位于氧的下方，因此能形成相同的键，却改变了分子的大小与亲油性。
